title: Databricks: claude-opus-4-1 rejects strict and claude-sonnet-4-5 rejects defer_loading
note: Owner's live sweep of Databricks models showed older Claude services reject strict and defer_loading; scripted fixtures cannot know gateway per-model field support.

title: Databricks: open-weight chat services reject max_completion_tokens; set compat.max_tokens
note: Seven open-weight Databricks services 400 on max_completion_tokens; entry_for never set compat.max_tokens, only visible against the real gateway.

title: openai-completions: round-trip Gemini thought signatures on tool calls
note: Gemini via openai-completions drops extra_content thought_signature, so the second request of a tool turn 400s; native path kept it, scripted provider cannot enforce it.

title: Databricks: gemini-4-argon fails on reasoning_effort; give it no thinking levels
note: Thinking overlay levels came from Vertex native API, but the Databricks gateway rejects reasoning_effort for argon; fixed by overlay data row.

title: Warm-cache startup emits model_invalid twice for one invalid model
note: Load and add_lua each admit the same cached model list, so two notices; the model_omitted twin was fixed and tested, this warm-cache path was not.

title: First run opens /login when any one installed provider has no credential
note: Owner signed in landed in login overlay because logged_out non-empty was taken as no credential; closed as duplicate of #4576.

title: Side panel: count the running turn, drop the compaction explainer line
note: Panel counted TurnCompleted so showed turns 0 during first turn, disagreeing with session_status; snapshots also pinned the dropped explainer line.

title: Settings stays in its search layout after the query is deleted
note: Doc said nothing about an emptied search query; owner ruled it closes like Esc and the fix added the sentence plus screen tests.

title: The input box's cursor is near-invisible in the dark theme
note: Cursor drew explicit surface-on-text colours that resolve to terminal background in dark theme; existing cursor tests pinned the markers, not a true reversal.

title: Jig freshness check refuses every run when the branch ref is packed
note: Freshness check treated missing git ref path in dep-info as stale in worktrees with packed refs; lanes hit it, CI checkouts never do.

title: First run opens sign-in when any provider is logged out, not when all are
